{{Quote|But I don't know which one we're in right&mdash; ''[&hellip;]'' RK-oh-one-four-oh|Princess Leia Organa, to Colonel Airen Cracken|<ref name="Choices" />}}
'''RK-oh-one-four-oh''' was an intersection in the [[Cave/Legends|cave]] systems below the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Minor]]'s surface.<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] members [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] passed the intersection while fleeing from the [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Ranquiv]]'s forces aboard a [[Speeder bus/Legends|speeder bus]] they [[Thief/Legends|stole]] from the [[Alien/Legends|alien]]. Organa reported that they just passed RK-oh-one-four-oh to [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Cracken]] through [[Comlink/Legends|comm]] so that Cracken could send Alliance forces to rescue the pair.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
RK-oh-one-four-oh appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
